Other words

  • bulga, bulgae f. — a bag, a leather pouch

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. bulga: a leathern knapsack, bag (a Gaulish word, Festus); Traupman 211, 216; Lucil. ap. Non. 78 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 275; Lucil. ap. Non. p. 78: sacculus ad bracchium pendēns (Lewis & Short); Traupman 325

    A Gaulish word; Lucilius: sacculus ad bracchium pendēns.

  • vidulus, vidulī m. — a larger leather bag

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 216: bigger than a bulga

    Classically a leather travelling bag or trunk (Plaut. Rud.); see suitcase.

See also pocket, leather bag.
